BEHIND THIS PRIVATE STUDY

Built on
real details.

Research, provenance, and a few things
still to learn from Frank.

The scope.

This is a private, unofficial website concept. Frank has not commissioned, reviewed, or approved it. It is served locally and is not a store.

Research checked on September 20, 2026. All 54 product sitemaps in Evolution Music’s public sitemap index were scanned for Gatto-branded URLs. The scan found 39 records: 37 guitar listings and two related items. 2 guitars were listed as available; 7 guitar records had no published photographs. A retail record is not necessarily a unique instrument: repeated sales or relistings may be present.

This covers the retailer’s currently reachable archive, not every guitar Frank has ever built. Search also located a sold Reverb listing for a transparent-black Tele-style guitar; it corresponds by title to an Evolution record and has not been counted as another build.

The person.

  • Down Home Guitars — instructor biography ↗

    Frank’s musical background, teaching, repairs, and Gatto Guitars.

  • Down Home Guitars — November/December 2017 newsletter ↗

    Guitar-building feature and the quotation about character in wood. Six years of building in 2017 suggests circa 2011, not a verified founding date.

  • The Usual Suspects ↗

    Current band affiliation and portrait source.

The imagery.

Instrument galleries use the retailer’s original photographs, downloaded for this private design study. Frank’s portrait comes from The Usual Suspects website. Their publication and reuse permissions have not been established for a public commercial launch.

The Gatto masthead is a vector transcription of the actual photographed headstock lettering. It is a working restoration; original logo artwork would be preferable for final brand production.

The candy-green homepage campaign image is AI-assisted artwork based on the actual listing photograph. It is not a documentary condition image. The tonewood image is generated conceptual artwork, not a photograph of Frank’s workshop. All instrument detail galleries use original photographs.

Still to learn.

Frank’s exact start date, workshop story, favorite builds, current custom-order process, preferred contact route, and original brand artwork. Those details would make the next version more personal without guessing.
